result.title: Scale-Aware Reference Attention for Mannequin-to-Model Gown Generation
result.summary: Formal gowns are sold online with photos of models wearing them, and buyers zoom in to inspect sequins, lace and beading. Image editors can turn a photo of a gown on a mannequin into a convincing photo of a person wearing it, but they receive every reference photo without any notion of its magnification, and the fine detail of the gown is lost when the output is viewed up close. We propose scale-aware reference attention (SARA), which tells an open diffusion transformer the zoom level of the output and of every reference photo, biases the attention of the output toward references of a similar zoom level, uses macro photos of the fabric as references, and is trained on a mix of whole-garment and zoomed targets. To train and evaluate it, we introduce Kiss3000, a dataset of 915 high-resolution mannequin photos and 2274 on-model photos of formal gowns with cross-domain pairs and splits by style, and zoom-crop evaluation, which compares garment crops at full, half and local scale without pixel alignment and judges local fidelity with two vision-language models gated on control crops. With this protocol, Nano Banana Pro at 4K, the highest-resolution commercial editor we test, loses or redraws local detail on 14 of 20 test gowns. At 1536x2048 pixels, both judges prefer SARA over a LoRA fine-tuning baseline on 18 test items and the baseline on 6 (p=0.023), and over the base model on 26 against 4 (p=5.9e-5), while SARA keeps the gown design as often as the baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SARA：把输出目标与每张参考图的缩放级别输入开放 diffusion transformer，使输出注意力偏向同尺度参考，并用织物微距照片作参考、以整衣与放大目标混合训练；同时发布 Kiss3000 数据集与不依赖像素对齐的 zoom-crop 评测协议。
AI.relevance_reason: 按显式尺度元信息调制参考注意力、偏好同尺度参考的做法，可能为 LVR 中多尺度视觉证据筛选与注意力路由提供线索；其放大裁切加 VLM 判官评价局部保真的协议也供核查，但任务属图像生成，迁移性需读原文判断。
